title: Tomaquet Amb Pa
description: A classic Spanish snack made with fresh tomato and bread.
instructions: 1. Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cut the tomato in half and brush with olive oil.
3. Grill the tomato for 2-3 minutes per side, or until charred and tender.
4. Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until crispy and lightly browned.
5. Once the tomato is cooked, let it cool for a minute or two.
6. Rub the grilled tomato on top of the toasted bread slices.
7. Season with salt to taste, and serve immediately.
